title: IPC admin.endpoints.set_alias result
description: What a rename did. `renamed`: the added entry carries the alias, written and synced before the answer. `unchanged`: the alias the entry already has, nothing written. A REFUSAL IS AN ANSWER, nothing written. An id no entry holds is the error `EndpointUnknown`. `detail` is for a log.

refused.$comment: Present exactly when outcome is refused, checked in this order: authored (the alias of a config.yaml entry is the file's); alias_invalid (outside the alias grammar); alias_taken (another entry, authored or added, holds it).
